blocks.text: LUCENA CITY—Anti-narcotics operatives arrested an armed suspected high-value drug trafficker, seizing over P380,000 worth of “shabu” (crystal meth) and an undocumented firearm in a buy-bust operation in Tagaytay City, Cavite, on Tuesday morning.
